item.title: IoT Monitoring of Dengue and Zika Mosquitoes
item.description:
Institution

Geo Visual Analytics Lab, IGIS, NUST
May 2023 - Dec 2023

Project Description

Dengue and Zika are spread by mosquitoes, and knowing where those mosquitoes are helps predict where an outbreak is likely. This project built an IoT system to monitor them automatically.

Project Highlights

  • Built the real-time data collection setup on Raspberry Pi devices.
  • Used OpenCV and machine learning to detect mosquitoes in the captured images.
  • Ran a four-week workshop on Python for computer vision.

Technical Skills Acquired

  • Raspberry Pi
  • OpenCV
  • Machine Learning
  • IoT

item.title: Adaptive Irrigated Agriculture Monitoring (Embedded + Cloud)
item.description:
Project Description

This was an IoT system for keeping track of conditions in the field. Embedded sensor nodes measured soil and air conditions and sent the readings to the cloud in real time, so irrigation could follow what the crop actually needed instead of a fixed schedule.

Project Highlights

  • Built the embedded sensor setup that reads soil and air conditions.
  • Connected the sensor nodes to the cloud for real-time monitoring.
  • Used the incoming data to decide when and how much to irrigate.

Technical Skills Acquired

  • Embedded Systems
  • IoT
  • Sensors
  • Cloud Integration
